steps: Keep V19, Challenger C1 and P75 Shadow running; the collector is read-only
Confirm local_config.json state_root paths if prompted
Share the generated GOLD_SHADOW_OPERATIONAL_SNAPSHOT_*.zip for audit
concurrent_write_policy: If a source ledger changes during collection, mark the snapshot non-atomic and collect again; do not stop or alter the source runtime automatically.
do_not: Do not copy this collector into a source state root
Do not edit V19, Challenger C1 or P75 files
Do not infer zero performance from a missing optional system
